what: Extract a full-body 3D human mesh from a single video frame using SAM 3D Body, guided by a text prompt to refine pose and shape estimation. The workflow loads one video and one text prompt, then outputs a reconstructed video showing the recovered human rig. Ideal for motion capture prototyping, biomechanics analysis, and character animation previsualization.
